RAYNOOR SMART MOTION DETECTION & INSTANT ALERTS – Stay informed with push notifications sent to your phone when motion is detected. RAYNOOR MULTI-DEVICE SUPPORT & HOTSPOT MODE – Seamlessly connect one camera to multiple users or manage several cameras on one app. No Wi-Fi? No problem. Insert an SD card (not included), and the camera records in hotspot mode without an internet connection.
